title: Pick tracks and show their coordinates
summary: Lets the user click tracks with ChooseLocation and GetObjectAtXYAskUserIfAmbiguous and reports each track's end points in mils relative to the board origin; an At=x,y parameter runs the same hit test without a click.
phrasings: get the start and end point of a clicked track
let the user click a location on the board
find the object at a point on the PCB
convert internal units to mils relative to the origin

commands.name: ShowTrackCoord
commands.description: Pick tracks and show their coordinates
commands.params: Max=<n> (optional)|Pick=true (pipe: prompt for clicks)|At=<x,y> (optional, mils from the board origin)
